purpose: Source-linked review of existing reference rules and safety disposition. Software decisions and synthetic tests are not clinical validation.
scope: No new symptom options, condition IDs, anatomy models, treatment prescriptions or remote medical inference.

entries.type: Conservative application output policy

sources.title: SANJO guideline: diagnostic approach, recommendations 1 and 3
sources.use: A clinical presentation alone cannot confirm or exclude joint infection; suspected infection requires timely assessment.

sources.title: MSD Professional: Splenic Injury
sources.use: Trauma assessment requires attention to potentially serious causes; a superficial reference match cannot establish stability.

sources.title: NHS: chest pain
sources.use: The action for high-risk chest symptoms must not be reduced by a benign-looking reference match.

sources.title: NHS: blood in urine
sources.use: Blood in urine warrants prompt assessment; associated fever changes the immediate evaluation context without proving obstruction.

sources.title: NHS: ectopic pregnancy symptoms
sources.use: Actual pain, shoulder-tip pain or fainting with possible pregnancy changes urgency. Pregnancy possibility alone does not establish pain.

sources.title: MSD Professional: Jaundice
sources.use: Fever and abdominal symptoms are important associated findings; laboratory tests and imaging are needed to distinguish causes.

entries.decision: Separate immediate, same-day and prompt assessment guidance from rule-match scores. When a priority warning is triggered, retained reference cards use the most urgent actual guidance instead of their routine self-care instructions. Priority cards do not display a numerical rank.
entries.appliesTo: Only inputs that already trigger an explicit priority rule. The ordinary no-warning path is unchanged. Coexisting warnings remain visible and are ordered by disposition.
notEstablished: The sources do not validate this application's scores or diagnostic accuracy.
A missing checkbox is unknown, not a negative examination.
A prompt or same-day recommendation is not silently promoted to an emergency recommendation.

positiveExamples.expected: Immediate assessment remains the action on every retained card, including an abdominal-wall reference match.
The bowel-reference score cannot override the same-day assessment instruction.
Immediate guidance precedes prompt guidance; neither warning is discarded.

negativeExamples.expected: No new priority warning; the existing ordinary reference advice is retained.
Prompt assessment remains prompt, not an automatic emergency disposition.
Timing and location alone do not establish abdominal pain.
A risk-context checkbox alone does not invent pain or a condition card.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping
entries.decision: Swelling/redness and local heat or purulent drainage around an existing joint region receive same-day assessment even if fever is unreported. This does not confirm joint infection or gout.
positiveExamples: Patella.r: 红肿 + 局部发热 + 无法承重
Patella.r: 局部肿胀 + 局部压痛 + 流脓, without reported heat or fever
negativeExamples: Patella.r: 局部肿胀 only; 发热 only
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping
entries.decision: Head pain with fever, progression or neurological changes prompts assessment. Explicit sudden motor loss, or sudden head pain with diplopia, requires immediate assessment. Fatigue is not substituted for motor weakness.
positiveExamples: Frontal bone: 紧箍感 + 发热 + 持续加重
Scaphoid bone.r: 肌力下降 + 突然起病
negativeExamples: Frontal bone: 跳痛 + 畏光 only
Scaphoid bone.r: 疲劳乏力 + 突然起病
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping

sources.title: MSD Professional: Neck and Back Pain, Red flags

entries.decision: Actual neck/back pain plus fever or chills changes disposition; posture-related clues cannot explain it away. No unselected fever or bilateral/gait finding is invented.
positiveExamples: Lumbar vertebra L3: 酸痛 + 久坐后 + 活动后缓解 + 发热
negativeExamples: Lumbar vertebra L3: 酸痛 + 久坐后 + 活动后缓解
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping
entries.decision: Exercise-related local/limb pain independent of the selected model tissue with dark urine and weakness/swelling/worsening are assessed immediately. No new disease card is added; dark urine does not establish myoglobinuria and missing the combination does not exclude disease.
positiveExamples: Rectus femoris muscle.r: 酸痛 + 新运动后1至3天 + 尿色深 + 肌力下降
Tibia.l: 酸痛 + 新运动后1至3天 + 尿色深 + 肌力下降 uses the same warning as a muscle selection
negativeExamples: Rectus femoris muscle.r: 酸痛 + 新运动后1至3天
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping

sources.title: Merck Professional: Knee Sprains and Meniscal Injuries

entries.decision: Inability to bear weight or joint locking after selected trauma/twisting requires same-day assessment. The app does not apply Ottawa imaging rules, grade an injury or exclude fracture.
positiveExamples: Talus.r: 扭伤后 + 无法承重 + 局部肿胀
Patella.r: 扭伤后 + 关节卡住
negativeExamples: Talus.r: 扭伤后 + 局部肿胀
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping

sources.title: ICHD-3: episodic and chronic tension-type headache

entries.decision: Explicit vomiting blocks the uncomplicated tension-type reference. Photophobia alone and nausea of uncollected severity are not blanket exclusions. Full ICHD diagnostic criteria are not implemented.
positiveExamples: Frontal bone: 紧箍感 + 双侧头痛 + 呕吐 blocks tension reference
negativeExamples: Frontal bone: 紧箍感 + 双侧头痛 + 畏光 keeps qualified reference
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping
entries.decision: The existing symmetric-pattern card requires the existing explicit symmetric-distribution tag. Lack of that tag is unknown, not evidence against all polyneuropathy.
positiveExamples: Tibia.l: 麻木 + 双侧手足对称 retains reference
negativeExamples: Tibia.l: 灼烧 + 感觉减退 does not invent symmetry
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping
entries.decision: The dedicated down-leg reference needs the selected leg course and a separate sensory/motor observation. General radiation and down-leg radiation share one evidence family. This is a conservative display gate, not a medical requirement for radiculopathy.
positiveExamples: Lumbar vertebra L3: 放射痛 + 沿腿向下 + 麻木
negativeExamples: Lumbar vertebra L3: 放射痛 + 麻木; 放射痛 + 沿腿向下
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional-source review with conservative software mapping

sources.title: MSD Professional: Neck and Back Pain, neurological red flags

entries.decision: Ulnar-distribution symptoms alone do not establish the elbow as the lesion site. Existing cord-reference wording describes selected findings rather than asserting unreported bilateral symptoms or gait changes.
positiveExamples: Scaphoid bone.r: 无名小指麻木 + 夜间麻木 retains nonlocalized reference
Lumbar vertebra L3: 排尿困难 + 放射痛
notEstablished: No clinical diagnostic validation, no inferred negative examination, and no new options or condition IDs.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping
entries.decision: Reported haematemesis requires immediate contact for medical assessment independently of selected anatomy. Current inputs do not confirm that bleeding has stopped or that the person is stable. The emergency-care conditions remain explicit.
positiveExamples: Sternum: 呕血
negativeExamples: Sternum: 灼烧 alone
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping
entries.decision: Actual pain/tenderness after trauma in a left upper reference area needs same-day evaluation; shoulder-tip pain, fainting or sudden severe pain increases immediacy. Anatomy selection does not confirm splenic injury or haemodynamic stability.
positiveExamples: LUQ abdominal muscle: 疼痛 + 外伤后
Spleen: 肩尖痛 + 外伤后
negativeExamples: Spleen: 外伤后 without a selected pain/tenderness observation
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping
entries.decision: Flank colic or flank-to-groin radiation with fever/chills receives immediate assessment. Haematuria is not required; neither stones nor infected obstruction are diagnosed by these selections.
positiveExamples: Kidney.l: 绞痛 + 腰腹向腹股沟放射 + 发热
Ureter.l: 绞痛 + 腰腹向腹股沟放射 + 发冷
negativeExamples: Lumbar vertebra L3/flank: 绞痛 without fever
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping

sources.title: MSD Professional: Jaundice, interpretation and red flags

entries.decision: Right upper pain with fever/chills needs same-day assessment without requiring fatty meals or high fever. The combined pain/fever/jaundice signal is escalated for possible biliary infection or obstruction; not a confirmed diagnosis.
positiveExamples: Gallbladder: 疼痛 + 发热
RUQ abdominal muscle: 疼痛 + 发热 + 黄疸
negativeExamples: RUQ location with 发热 alone does not invent local pain
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping

sources.title: MSD Professional: Acute Pancreatitis, Symptoms and Diagnosis

entries.decision: Worsening upper/left-upper pain with vomiting warrants assessment even without reported back radiation. The existing multi-feature pancreatic reference also accepts LUQ, but no pancreatic diagnosis is made without examination, enzymes/imaging. The existing back-radiation label explicitly describes pain and does not require a redundant generic pain checkbox for triage; disease-card gates are unchanged.
positiveExamples: Pancreas: 疼痛 + 呕吐 + 持续加重
LUQ abdominal muscle: 疼痛 + 向背部放射 + 呕吐
Pancreas: 向背部放射 + 呕吐, without an extra 疼痛 checkbox
negativeExamples: Stomach: 餐后饱胀 + 恶心 without the reviewed warning combination
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping

sources.title: NIDDK: Symptoms and Causes of Constipation

entries.decision: Constipation with fever/chills or vomiting needs same-day medical assessment; removing a constipation card alone must not leave routine fibre/observation advice.
positiveExamples: Descending colon: 便秘 + 干硬便 + 发热
Descending colon: 便秘 + 干硬便 + 呕吐
negativeExamples: Descending colon: 便秘 + 干硬便
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Professional/official-source review with bounded disposition mapping

sources.title: AHA/ACC: 2021 Chest Pain Guideline, anginal equivalents

entries.decision: Upper abdominal pressure with cold sweat is not assigned solely to a gastric cause. The app conservatively maps unspecified onset to same-day assessment and explicit sudden/ongoing symptoms to immediate assessment. This combination-specific mapping is an application safety inference, not a validated clinical score.
positiveExamples: Epigastric abdominal muscle: 压迫感 + 冷汗
Epigastric abdominal muscle: 压迫感 + 冷汗 + 突然起病
negativeExamples: Epigastric abdominal muscle: 压迫感 + 恶心 without cold sweat
notEstablished: No condition, stability, obstruction or exact pain origin is confirmed by selecting anatomy. Unchecked signs remain unknown.

entries.type: Input-fidelity engineering decision grounded in the existing label meanings

sources.title: AHA/ACC Chest Pain Guideline: pressure/tightness terminology

entries.decision: The existing exertional chest-pressure label counts as chest discomfort for triage. Related radiation labels are recognized as reported pain where their displayed text explicitly says pain, without adding an independent evidence family or diagnosing a cardiac condition.
positiveExamples: Heart: 运动诱发胸闷 + 冷汗
Sternum: 运动诱发胸闷 + 气短
Sternum: 局部压痛 + 活动诱发 + 气短
negativeExamples: Heart: 运动诱发胸闷 alone does not produce a cardiac diagnosis card
Timing alone does not establish pain
Sternum: 局部压痛 + 活动诱发 remains non-emergency
Shoulder-tip or flank pain is not relabeled as local upper abdominal pain solely from a model location
notEstablished: Neither cardiac disease nor a specific organ lesion is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Oral/facial swelling or pus plus restricted opening receives emergency assessment without waiting for fever or pain. A simple jaw-joint explanation must not lower that action.
positiveExamples: Mandible: 面部肿胀 + 张口受限
Lower canine.l: 牙龈肿胀 + 张口受限
negativeExamples: Lower canine.l: 紧绷 without infection/opening signs
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Dental pus, or local pain/swelling with fever, receives same-day urgent dental assessment. Hospital emergency escalation depends on opening, airway/swallowing or other spreading-infection signs; fever alone is not labeled severe spread.
positiveExamples: Lower canine.l: 流脓
Lower canine.l: 牙龈肿胀 + 发热
negativeExamples: Simple thermal sensitivity remains a non-emergency reference
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Lingering thermal/spontaneous/night pain or a reported cavity/crack prompts dental examination without waiting two days or fabricating a second finding. A short thermal-response pattern remains qualified rather than diagnosing dentin sensitivity.
positiveExamples: Lower canine.l: 持续冷热痛
Lower canine.l: 牙龋洞 or 牙齿裂纹, without pain
negativeExamples: Lower canine.l: 冷热敏感 + 刺激去除即缓解 is not automatically urgent
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Injured red eye, visual change, photophobia or reported severe pain receives emergency assessment. Less-specific post-injury discomfort receives same-day clarification without presuming severe or penetrating injury. Red eye plus visual change/light sensitivity receives emergency guidance even without injury. Ordinary eye-surface references cannot absorb a reported injury. Generic pus with a selected eye area does not prove ocular drainage; after injury use same-day source clarification with immediate eye assessment if it is from the eye itself.
positiveExamples: Lacrimal bone.l: 异物感 + 眼红 + 外伤后
Lacrimal bone.l: 复视 + 外伤后
Lacrimal bone.l: 畏光 + 外伤后
Lacrimal bone.l: 眼红 + 视物模糊
negativeExamples: Lacrimal bone.l: 眼干 + 长时间看屏幕
Isolated blurred vision is not automatically an emergency; post-injury discomfort alone does not prove severe trauma.
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Diplopia warrants examination even when intermittent. Explicit sudden onset changes this to same-day urgent assessment; post-injury or additional acute neurological warning paths retain the higher level. No monocular/binocular cause is inferred.
positiveExamples: Lacrimal bone.l: 复视 + 突然起病
Frontal bone: 复视 without unreported onset
negativeExamples: Ordinary eye dryness is not equated to diplopia
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Hearing reduction plus explicit sudden onset is handled consistently with the existing sudden-hearing-loss label. Same-day urgent assessment is not delayed by an ear-pain/infection reference; hearing-loss subtype and exact onset interval remain unconfirmed.
positiveExamples: Incus.l: 听力下降 + 突然起病
Incus.l: 疼痛 + 听力下降 + 突然起病
negativeExamples: Incus.l: 疼痛 alone does not establish sudden hearing loss
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Reported pus needs assessment rather than a musculoskeletal or uncomplicated irritation explanation. The selected bone/muscle does not establish the infection site or depth.
positiveExamples: Anterior longitudinal ligament: 流脓
Humerus.l: 痒 + 皮疹 + 流脓
negativeExamples: Humerus.l: 痒 + 皮疹 without an infection warning
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Skin changes or pus together with fever/chills receive same-day assessment for possible infection and other causes, without naming a new skin disease.
positiveExamples: Humerus.l: 灼烧 + 红斑 + 发热 + 持续加重
negativeExamples: Simple itchy rash without systemic change is not automatically escalated
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.type: Official/professional-source review with explicit uncertainty
entries.decision: Basic guidance provides conditional forward-leaning, soft-part pressure for 10–15 minutes without requiring trauma. Coarse hours/days input prompts same-day clarification, not an assertion of continuous heavy bleeding. Persistent bleeding after correct pressure or severe associated symptoms requires emergency care.
positiveExamples: Nasal structure: 鼻出血 alone receives conditional first aid
Nasal structure: 鼻出血 + 持续数小时 prompts review
negativeExamples: Unreported duration is not treated as hours of uncontrolled bleeding
notEstablished: No examination, lesion depth, specific diagnosis or unreported symptom duration is confirmed.

entries.decision: General reported swallowing difficulty warrants same-day medical advice; inability to swallow liquids remains conditional, not inferred. Oral swelling/pus with swallowing difficulty retains emergency disposition.
positiveExamples: Oesophagus: 吞咽困难
negativeExamples: Do not assert an unreported inability to swallow liquids or new onset.
notEstablished: No cause or severity is established by the checkbox.
